title: Unit Event — Live with Memories — Episode1 The Next Step

meta.Event Outline: The wind is in Leo/need's sails as the band continues performing and starts to build its own fanbase. But then, they encounter a brother and sister, who are Leo/need fans, having an argument.

rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much!
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whew! Great show, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, nice work.
Today's audience really seemed to enjoy it too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
They got so into it.
In that sense, it felt like we put on a real show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it's always nice to see others visibly enjoying our music like that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Totally!
Seeing them like that really got me going too♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Especially the ones at the front! They looked like they were having so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, hang on...
Are you talking about that boy and girl?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Those two always seem to be right at the front. They caught my eye while I was setting up my drum kit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And they always move to the front when we're about to take the stage.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I had a feeling we'd all remember them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The girl looked like she was in junior high, but I think the boy was about our age... Do you think they're friends or something...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think they're siblings. The way she said, “Yota, hurry,” made me believe that he was her older brother.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, they do kinda look alike.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They must be really close if they're coming to our shows together like this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They're just like you and Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's like we're all connected somehow♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, well...
Those two are always at the front during our shows, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does that make them our fans...? Or not...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, “fans” might not be...

rows.Speaker: Saki & Honami
rows.Line: You're right...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
They must be...!
If they're going out of their way to see us like this, that has to mean they're our fans...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I don't believe it!
We finally have actual fans!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
It's an incredible feeling...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, we're trying to go pro, so we're gonna need a dedicated fanbase to actually get there...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I guess it's a start...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That means we'll need to keep playing our best if we want them to keep coming back.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's keep this up!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, we can talk about when we'll be doing our next show during our usual debrief, and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd like to discuss what we'll be doing moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Moving forward?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Like what kinds of stuff we want to do as a band in the future.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can discuss details later, but for now, we need to keep learning as much as we can by watching other bands.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What we want to do as a band, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We couldn't really get the crowd going during our first few shows...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But we've been drawing in more people lately, so it definitely feels like we've been moving in the right direction.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I can't honestly say how we're going to grow as a band in the future...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I'd like it if we could keep improving one step at a time...)
Diner

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here's to another job well done, girls... Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, Ms. Shiho, lay it on us!
What do we need to do as a band moving forward?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Whoa, personal space.
Also, the debrief still comes first.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I kind of want to discuss our future as well. Do you already know what we should be doing as a band, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Fine, we'll start with that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's begin by seeing where we're at now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're currently able to put on decent shows each time on a regular schedule. We've even been selling tickets at a good pace too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Which means...
We may want to start thinking about taking the next step.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The next step...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Until now, we've been focusing on practicing so that we can perform well during shows and keep playing in as many as possible.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But if we want to get our name out there, we need to start doing more than just that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Of course, we're gonna keep doing what we have been up to this point.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That reminds me of what you said about how to actually go pro. One method involved getting enough people to come to our shows so that record companies begin noticing us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I remember too!
Another was posting videos of our songs online!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. There are a lot of ways to go pro, but they all involve getting people to start listening to our music...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That includes playing at different live houses, starting a band account to post videos, and all sorts of other stuff...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa!
Does that mean we're gonna make an official Leo/need account?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm not sure we're worthy of “official” just yet...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It'd be great to start uploading all the songs we've been playing until now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We could also start doing some street performances... Although, lugging around an entire drum kit and getting it set up might be tough...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It won't be easy, but it might be worth a try.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: After all, Ichika, you became so much better after playing in front of all those people.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is so exciting!
Oh, what if we tried something like this next?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Looks like they're really enjoying this.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Plus, the thought that we get to keep getting better as a band's so wonderful...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Alright...
I'm going to do everything I can so our name gets out there!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh, but just knowing our name won't be enough...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We have to keep those who've been going out of their way to see our shows in our thoughts too...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Great meeting today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, it really was!
I'm glad we were able to come up with so many ideas on top of our usual debrief.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Why don't we discuss which will work best for us next time?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Anyway, wanna head home?
Our next show's pretty soon, so we should probably rest up!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Huh? Interesting...
You're usually the one who wants to keep hanging out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. We have fans now!
That means we have to give them the best shows we can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree...
Let's make our next one good too!
Two weeks later

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Live House

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (More people are here compared to usual today. I'm singing pretty well too, so I should be able to reach everyone in the back...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Oh, those two are here again...
I'm so glad.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Huh...?
But the brother doesn't seem very happy...)
After the show
Outside the live house

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That was a great show.
And you sang with so much power today, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I bet everyone in the back was totally blown away!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hm? Is something wrong, Ichika?
You seem worried.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I don't think it's anything serious...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But those two were here again today. Did you all see them...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, they were here!
At the front as usual too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes...
But the brother didn't seem too happy to be there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Really?
I guess I couldn't tell because of all the equipment.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... You think something happened to them?
You big dummy...!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-That voice...? What's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Is someone fighting?
I've seen bands take their arguments outside of places before...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that voice sounded so familiar...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Gasp*
